title: Will the Federal Reserve cut rates before 2027?
rules_primary: If the Federal Reserve cuts its target federal funds rate range at least once between February 26, 2026 and December 31, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: The market will close and determine on the first 10 AM ET following the occurrence of the event if the event occurs prior to the target date.
normalization_notes: The window begins February 26, 2026. A qualifying FOMC announcement of a lower target federal funds rate range counts; changes to unrelated administered rates do not. Check already elapsed portions of the window as well as remaining meetings.
instruction: Only rules are supplied; no prices, order books, volume or prior forecasts. Do not browse exchange pages for price discovery.
